hooks.name: Remind honesty disclaimer on UI edits
hooks.description: When manuscript or result UI files change, inject a reminder to keep the AI-reconstruction disclaimer and honesty note visible.

action.prompt: A UI component was just saved. Verify that any view showing Illuminate or Resurrect results still displays (1) the persistent AI-reconstruction disclaimer and (2) the honesty note when present. Do not remove those labels. Avoid Kingdom Come: Deliverance names or assets.
